title: Hulkverines #1 2 3 Complete Set Marvel 2019 Greg Pak Weapon H Hulk Wolverine
condition_description: All three covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Hulkverines! #1, #2 and #3 (2019), Marvel Comics - the complete 3-issue limited series. Hulk + Wolverine + Weapon H. Written by Greg Pak, art by Ario Anindito (#1, #3) and Guiu Vilanova (#2), covers by Greg Land. $4.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #1 - "c'mon, you know you love it"
- #2 - "it's simple math!" (War of the Realms banner)
- #3 - "no pants are safe!"

Back covers: Captain Marvel (Citizen watch and film soundtrack) ads.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
